import warnings
from typing import Callable, Any

def wrap_wsgi_application(app: Callable[[Any], Any]) -> Callable[[Any], Any]:
    """
    Wraps a WSGI application to suppress unhandled deprecation warnings.
    
    Args:
    app (Callable[[Any], Any]): The original WSGI application to be wrapped.
    
    Returns:
    Callable[[Any], Any]: A new WSGI application that wraps the original one and suppresses deprecation warnings.
    """
    def wrapped_app(environ: Any, start_response: Any) -> Any:
        with warnings.catch_warnings():
            warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=DeprecationWarning)
            return app(environ, start_response)
    
    return wrapped_app
